title: Brother-in-law recalls warning suspect against drugs before KLIA quarters murder
summary: TUMPAT: The death of a 35-year-old civil servant might have been prevented, her brother-in-law said, recalling how he had advised the couple to resolve their differences peacefully and urged the victim’s husband to stay away from drugs.
